# GFX-HUB

> > GFX-HUB is a comprehensive digital art and design resource hub offering brushes, textures, software, plugins, tutorials, and assets for Photoshop, Procreate, Blender, Unity, and other creative applications.

The site serves digital artists, designers, and content creators with downloadable resources spanning 2D graphics (brushes, textures, patterns), 3D assets (Daz 3D, Poser), professional software (Adobe Lightroom, Luminar Neo), game development tools (Unity assets), and educational content from platforms like Udemy, Skillshare, and Gumroad. Resources are frequently organized into monthly bundles and cover skill levels from beginner to advanced.

## Key Topics

- Photoshop brushes and presets
- Procreate brush packs
- 2D textures and backgrounds
- Blender addons and plugins
- Unity game assets
- Daz 3D and Poser characters
- Adobe Lightroom and photo editing
- Digital art tutorials
- Design resources and templates
- Envato marketplace assets
- 3D modeling and Houdini
- AutoCAD and technical drawing
- Animation and illustration courses
- AI-powered image editing

## Professional Software & Applications

- [Adobe Lightroom Classic 2023 v12.2.0 Win x64](https://gfx-hub.cc/soft/graphics-design-apps/91797-adobe-lightroom-classic-2023-v1220-win-x64.html): Adobe Lightroom Classic 2023 desktop photo editor with GPU acceleration
- [Luminar Neo 1.7.0 (11072) Win/Mac x64](https://gfx-hub.cc/soft/graphics-design-apps/91949-luminar-neo-170-11072-win-mac-x64.html): Luminar Neo AI-powered image editor with RelightAI & MaskAI features
